reveal_en: For their first few months, human babies can breathe and swallow simultaneously without choking. This unique ability stems from a higher larynx position, which descends as they grow, enabling speech but preventing this dual action.
reveal_zh: 在出生后的最初几个月，人类婴儿可以同时呼吸和吞咽而不会呛到。这种独特能力源于他们较高的喉部位置，随着成长，喉部下降，使他们能说话，但也失去了这种二合一能力。
meaning_en: This temporary infant superpower illustrates an evolutionary trade-off, where developing complex speech required sacrificing earlier, critical survival functions.
meaning_zh: 婴儿这项短暂的“超能力”揭示了进化中的权衡，发展复杂的语言能力需要牺牲早期关键的生存功能。

visual.motion: Gentle, rhythmic ebb and flow, illustrating vital processes.
